reason: A Windows WPF/WebView2 desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness that manages the dsh service lifecycle, provides tray controls and autostart, and displays the service interface.

summaries.zh: 用于在 Windows 桌面上启动、管理和显示 DeepSeek Harness dsh 服务的 WPF/WebView2 启动器，支持托盘控制、自动重启和开机自启。
summaries.en: A Windows WPF/WebView2 launcher for starting, managing, and displaying the DeepSeek Harness dsh service with system-tray controls, automatic restart, and autostart.

capabilities: Launches and manages the dsh child process
Automatically restarts dsh after unexpected exit
Provides system-tray start, restart, and stop controls
Can invoke npx to download and run dsh when it is not installed
Loads the dsh service interface through WebView2
Writes operational logs to the user profile
